overall.verdict: The mobile-light variant demonstrates strong foundational design with excellent hierarchy, data legibility, and trust cues. However, it struggles with consistent visceral value representation across all screens and has several areas of visual noise that reduce the premium feel. The design successfully adapts to mobile constraints but could better leverage the available screen real estate.
priority_fixes: Implement visceral value bars consistently across all screens including modals and lists
Remove redundant headers and technical notes from primary screens
Improve bottom tab bar visibility and separation
Enhance status indicators and verification cues for better trust perception
Condense technical explanations and move them to appropriate settings screens
